verdict.rationale: Notte's docs say every session automatically includes clean, realistic browser fingerprints and built-in stealth features against anti-bot systems. They also say stealth mode can be combined with residential proxies, which the marketing site describes as a global network with fixed IPs and bring-your-own. Coverage is partial because the evidence is only short first-party snippets and does not show how proxies are configured or how to pick a country. missing for 10: documented proxy configuration and geo/country-targeting controls, detail on fingerprint customization, independent or hands-on confirmation that stealth plus proxies avoids bot blocking.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can enable stealth fingerprinting and residential or geo-targeted proxies so legitimate automations aren't blocked as bots
